sources.classification_reason: Deep dive component analysis for Corian (Solid Surface).

bottom_line: PMMA acrylic resin-based solid surface. Seamless, repairable, thermoformable — genuine functional advantages. BUT: heat vulnerable (damage begins ~200°F), scratches easily, requires periodic sanding. CorStar Capital ownership (post-DuPont). Fabricators moved on from Corian for high-end but it has a legitimate repairability niche.
